name: Pistol squat
goal: 5 strict pistol squats per leg, heel down, no counterweight

stages.name: Squat foundation
stages.work: Full-depth bodyweight squat, heels down; deep-squat holds; knee-to-wall ankle rocks; reverse lunges

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Deep squat, heels down
exercises.cue: Full depth, heels flat, chest up.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Elbows inside the knees, heels down. Two minutes in total is the standard for this stage.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, back knee to a hand off the floor, front heel down.

stages.name: Single-leg strength
stages.work: Bulgarian split squat, step-ups, 3 s down

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot up on the bench, front heel down, drop straight down.
exercises.note: Add a rep when every set feels clean. Three sets of 10 per leg is the standard for this stage.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the step, push through the heel, lower slowly.
exercises.note: Use a step that puts your thigh about level with the floor. Go higher once 8 are easy.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Heels down, chest up, sit in the bottom of the squat.

stages.name: Assisted pistol
stages.work: Full-depth pistol holding a pole, doorframe or rings

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol
exercises.cue: Hold the pole or doorframe, sit all the way down on one leg, use your hands as little as you can.
exercises.note: Pull a bit less each week. Stop a set if your knee pinches or your heel lifts.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot up on the bench, front heel down, drop straight down.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol bottom hold
exercises.cue: Hold the pole, sit at the bottom on one leg, free leg out in front, heel down.

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Box pistol (single-leg sit-to-stand)
exercises.cue: Sit back to the box on one leg, free leg out in front, stand up without a hand.
exercises.note: Start at 60 cm. Drop to 45 cm, then 35 cm, once all three sets reach 6 clean reps. Any firm seat or stack at the right height works.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot up on the bench, front heel down, drop straight down.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol, fingertips only
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the pole, full depth, heel down.

stages.name: Negatives
stages.work: Pistol negatives, 5 s to full depth, two legs to stand
ready: 3 × 5 per leg at 5 s to full depth

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Pistol negative
exercises.cue: Lower on one leg over five seconds, touch the bottom, then stand up using both legs.
exercises.note: Only the lowering is on one leg, so keep it slow and controlled. If you drop in the last seconds, do fewer reps. Stop if your knee pinches.

exercises.name: Box pistol from your lowest box
exercises.cue: Sit back to the box on one leg, stand up without a hand.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Heels down, arms out in front, sit in the bottom of the squat.

stages.name: Full pistol
stages.work: Counterweight held forward (2–5 kg) then dropped; heel flat
ready: 5 strict reps per leg, no counterweight

exercises.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Foot a hand-width from the wall, knee over the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Strict pistol test set
exercises.cue: Heel down, no hands, no weight. End a leg when your heel lifts or you fall out of the bottom.
exercises.note: Do this one while fresh. Five clean reps on each leg is the goal of this whole area.

exercises.name: Counterweight pistol

load.text: 2 to 5 kg held out in front, a little lighter each week

exercises.cue: Hold the weight out in front to balance, heel flat, stand up smoothly.
exercises.note: A light plate works. Drop to the lighter end as you get stronger, then drop the weight for the next exercise.

exercises.name: Strict pistol, no weight
exercises.cue: Arms out in front, heel flat, no bounce at the bottom.
